summary: The submission preserves its pre-collection baseline, blind-before-reveal ordering, hashes, same-work H2/H3 inputs, trust rejection, bounded pools, cleanup, fallback, and rollback. It requires revision because identity and communication completeness fail, the average is 2.10, and material rubric gaps remain in quantitative budgeting, causal TCP diagnosis, protocol reasoning, decision ownership, and teach-back. The preserved blind ordering and nonzero safety scores avoid Repeat.
